name.purpose: The full name across the viewport in the hero and as the footer mark. 14.5vw and wrapping below 960px.

statement.purpose: The single About statement; the contact email shares its weight.

title.purpose: Entry headings in a ruled, dated list.

item.purpose: Entries of a plain list such as skills.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under a section heading, in Slate Mute, max 46ch. Also the hero intro and index names.

label.purpose: Navigation, fact rows, column headings, footer.

caption.purpose: Figure captions and the kind beside each index name.

shadows.name: media-ring
shadows.purpose: A hairline ring around screenshots. The only box-shadow in the system; it acts as a border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Link and index row colour change.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Underlines drawing from the left; navigation hiding.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section headings rising from behind a mask, once.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: portrait 1.6s, name 1.2s after .15s, details .9s from .55s in .09s steps
motion.purpose: Page load sequence in the hero.

motion.name: scrub
motion.purpose: Portrait drift and dim, name rise, statement words brightening, pinned project sinking to scale .94 and opacity .25.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied under prefers-reduced-motion and with the ?still query.

narrative.overview:
The page is the photograph, continued. The ground is the dark navy of the studio backdrop behind the portrait, so the picture has no edge: it is feathered on its sides and top and fades out below the chest, and the page simply carries on in the same colour. Everything else is set directly on that ground. There are no panels, no tinted sections and no second surface colour behind text.

The voice is one typeface at two extremes. Geist is set very large and tight for the name, the section headings and the project titles, and small and quiet for everything that explains them. Structure comes from hairline rules and from space, never from boxes. One azure is the only colour that is not navy or cool white, and it marks things you can act on.

The site is a single dark theme by design, because a light ground would cut the portrait out of its own backdrop. Motion follows the same restraint: lines rise from behind a mask, things ease out and settle, and all of it switches off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One ground colour for the whole page, taken from the portrait's backdrop.
One typeface, Geist, at very large display sizes and small text sizes with little in between.
Hairline rules (1px, 16% cool white) separate rows; nothing is boxed.
One azure accent, reserved for actions and their hover states.
Two radii only: pills for controls, 6px for media.
Real screenshots are the only large light areas on the page.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on Backdrop Night. A section never gets its own background, tint or gradient wash; separation is a hairline or space.

rules.name: The Azure Means Action Rule
rules.body: Azure appears on things you can press or have just hovered, plus the project kind line. It is never used for decoration, large fills or body text.

rules.name: The Two Extremes Rule
rules.body: A line of type is either a tight display line (weight 600 or 500, negative tracking, line-height at or under 1.25) or quiet text between 14px and 20px. Weight 700 and weight 300 are loaded but unused; no text is set in uppercase and nothing is letter-spaced wider than normal.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label and button is written in sentence case.

rules.name: The No Surface Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If something needs to be in front, it covers what is behind it edge to edge on Backdrop Night; it does not get a shadow, a blur or a raised panel.

dos: Do keep every section on Backdrop Night and separate content with a hairline or with space.
Do use azure only for actions, hover states, focus, selection and the project kind line.
Do make every control a full pill and every piece of media 6px-cornered.
Do set headings tight and large in weight 600 or 500, and explanatory text between 14px and 20px.
Do keep text columns to 46ch for leads and descriptions and 56ch for supporting lines.
Do show real screenshots with a caption that says what they are.
Do use the one house ease, and give every animated element a visible resting state without script and under reduced motion.
Do keep pinned layouts behind the width and height conditions so no link becomes unreachable.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a section with its own background colour; the ground is the portrait's backdrop.
Don't put content in cards, panels or raised surfaces.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or blurs. The 1px ring on screenshots is the only box-shadow.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or a second typeface.
Don't use icons; every control is labelled in words.
Don't set text in uppercase or with widened letter-spacing.
Don't put a bar or fill behind the navigation.
Don't give the hero portrait a frame, a border or a rounded crop; it dissolves into the ground.
